primaryChecks.text: Out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Hammothdor with its pasture lands, and Kartan with its pasture lands: three cities.
contextRefs: JOS 21:31 — Helkath with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands: four cities.
JOS 21:33 — All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.

wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: 町一覧表のHammoth-Dor行と直上のHammath行を読み、同一説が疑問符付きであること、場所候補二つを確認。固定WEB JOS21:31–33に照合。

geographyAssessment.reasonJa: 本文でナフタリ領のレビ人の町として直接記される。旧候補点は記事の複数候補域とは矛盾しないが未確認。同じ町一覧にあるHammathとは別IDを保ち、?の同一説を留保。

limitationsJa: 固定WEB本文・前後とWikipediaの町一覧表の当該行を実読。旧候補点は独立測地照合していない。
